description: This file contains functions for executing various user actions and expectations within a browser automation context, including navigation, clicking, filling forms, and assertions, with detailed tracing and error handling.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes a specified user action on a page, handling instrumentation, error capturing, and result serialization.

methods.name: innerRunAction
methods.description: Performs the specific action logic based on the action method, such as navigation, clicking, filling, or expectations.

methods.name: runExpect
methods.description: Runs an expectation/assertion on a frame element, with timeout and error handling.

methods.name: traceParamsForAction
methods.description: Generates tracing parameters for a given action, used for logging or debugging.

methods.name: callMetadataForAction
methods.description: Creates metadata for a specific action call, including timing and tracing info.

methods.name: expectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration based on the mode ('generate' or 'run').
